scope: Final wrapper adds original-plan checks absent from helper; no runtime/script changes
full_matrix: 3 presets x 2 TM seeds x 10 Dev10 routes
completion: Each seed candidate mean completion >= max(CARLA,TCP) mean completion. This does not change fixed lateral reference.
lateral_reference: Frozen CARLA lateral + PI Kp.5 Ki.25 additive
lateral: Full-route RMS mean equally weighted across requested routes/seeds, candidate <= .8 * reference; before-collision shown separately and never substituted.
speed: Trajectory-reference RMS route mean candidate <= reference + .1; keep independent cruise and official comfort distinction.
failure_counts: Show incomplete route IDs/counts for every preset/seed; compare candidate against each reference and against the reference(s) with maximal mean completion in that seed. Root reviews original no-increased-failure rule before adoption.
failure_causes: Official blocked/deviation plus observed stalls, TickRuntime and long low-progress require evidence labels controller/external/unknown; zero official blocked does not prove no stalls.
strict_sr: Selected official status Completed/Perfect AND no nonempty infraction list except min_speed_infractions. Requested subset denominator10; not full220.
